name: Camping Biberhof
beschreibung: Camping Biberhof is situated in Biberwier near the Fern Pass in Tyrol, at an elevation of around 1,000 metres. The campsite features pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, all equipped with electricity connections. The sanitary building provides separate showers and toilets, as well as a baby changing room. A children's playground and table tennis facilities offer leisure options on site. The campsite has its own reception desk offering information about regional excursion destinations. In winter, the ski areas of Ehrwald and Lermoos are just a few minutes' drive away. Its location along the Fernpass route offers convenient accessibility for transit travellers.
